text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Last year's Halloween, which drew an overwhelming level of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Recognized for her achievements—the one appointed
as producer for this year's Halloween event
was Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone. I have no intention of tying everyone down with micromanagement.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let your passion explode with ideas, and let's create a Halloween even better than last year's!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's use everyone's ideas
to make this the best Halloween show ever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's idea is Super Spicy Zombie Pro Wrestling!
It's a deathmatch show where zombie wrestlers
fight using chili sauce as their weapons!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea too!
Gunslinger cosplay with a Western set!
A realistic shooting game!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't fall behind...! I need to
come up with entertainment that's every bit
as good as everyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the whole academy fired up and full of motivation,
preparations for Halloween pressed on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey everyone, good work!
How are the preparations coming along?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Producer, look!
The pro wrestling ring is almost finished, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Western movie set is coming along steadily too!
It puts Hollywood to shame, yes indeed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, amazing!
We can safely assume that the excitement
is already guaranteed to surpass last year's.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay! We got the Producer's
stamp of approval, yes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...A bat. But are you all
satisfied with just that?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Geh?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing who we are now, after having already surpassed who we were last year.
Don't you want to create a world like that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"—This world is vast.
It's brimming with possibilities, and even at this very moment, unimaginable things are taking place."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Soul-stirring art, science like magic—
unimaginable wonders shine like pearls,
filling the heart with excitement."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes—for example. Our races are like one of those pearls, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that together, we can do it.
We'll bring to life an unprecedented Halloween
that will captivate the whole academy—no, the whole world!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Ohhhhhh!!
I am gonna do iiit, yeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Making use of the set
for a paintball battle game
would be super fun too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Advertising is important too... Let's make an announcement to the world! Our Halloween!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—on the day of Halloween.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Man
text_block_list.text:
"...What? What is this livestream?
'Tracen World Halloween'?"

text_block_list.name: Foreign Man
text_block_list.text: "...Amazing! What is this event!? It's as if every form of entertainment has gathered in one place—"

text_block_list.name: Cruise Ship Passenger
text_block_list.text:
"A costumed group is running through the sky...!?
Just what kind of trick is this!
It's truly astonishing, Mike!"

text_block_list.name: Cruise Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
""No time to waste... Change our course!
We're heading for Japan immediately!""

text_block_list.name: International Visitors
text_block_list.text:
"Woaaah!
What're you gonna show us next, Tracen?!"
choice_data_list: I never thought it would come to this—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, surprised?
Though... to me, it was the obvious outcome.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because the passion of us Umamusume...
has infinite potential!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone across the globe!
Our Halloween entertainment...
Savor it until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate entertainment crafted around Seeking the Pearl...
Halloween had moved the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, the voltage is rising!
I'm gonna hit everyone with a rush of entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate entertainment crafted around Seeking the Pearl...
Halloween had moved the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling performance and entertainment!
Enjoy it until your head spins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate entertainment crafted around Seeking the Pearl...
Halloween had moved the entire world.
